take: St. Louis announced it placed left winger Alexey Toropchenko on injured reserve. He played one game this season, about five minutes on the fourth line, and the Blues controlled only 17 percent of the quality of chances with him on the ice at five-on-five. In the five games since he went out, Zach Dean has taken his spot beside Johnston and Suter, while Connor McMichael (now 16:55 a night) and Jake Neighbours (14:58) have picked up the extra ice time.
